warm: file read once before the clock
cold: drop_caches after warmup, before the timed read

versions.extxyz-ng: not installed: 0.0.2 replaces the extxyz 0.4.6 import; extxyz 0.4.6 kept

notes: OVITO 3.17.2 reads extended XYZ periodicity and an out-of-cell second frame without wrapping or repeating frame 0.
A timed write is rejected unless its file is non-empty, inside that format's size range, and reads back at the full atom count. That check runs after the clock stops.

Every write sample except the 1M readcon-con row is the interleaved fresh-process measurement from this session. The clock is serialise and store of a structure that already exists: see each row's Clock note. The 1M readcon-con write is the back-to-back serial measurement, 0.1701 s. Default threads are 0.0577 s. Chemfiles has no CON writer, so its write cell is 'no writer'.
chemfiles has no native CON format; the chemfiles-con row copies positions and the cell out of a chemfiles Frame filled from readcon.
chemfiles compression library (bundled) opens {"bz2": true, "gz": true, "trr": true, "xz": true}
mda-h5md omitted; MDAnalysis 2.11.0 H5MDReader needs h5py, which is not installed.
mda-mmcif omitted; MDAnalysis 2.11.0 MMCIFReader needs gemmi, which is not installed.
MDAnalysis 2.11.0 on DCD, XTC, NetCDF, TRR, XYZ, PDB, H5MD and mmCIF where those readers import. Cells are orthogonal, so the 2.11 triclinic wrap does not apply.

extxyz-ng 0.0.2 was not added. Installing that wheel on the default path replaces the extxyz 0.4.6 module (same import name, no read_dicts). extxyz 0.4.6 stays. The side prefix build/bench/extxyz-ng-0.0.2 was not present, so there is no read arm. bench/h2h/install_extxyz_ng.sh installs the hashed wheel there.
mdcompress 1.0.0 is not on PyPI. The refresh-bio binary and its in-memory reader were not both available, so the row is omitted.

1M readcon-con serial fresh-process read 0.0964 s, default threads 0.0917 s. The table row is the interleaved serial measurement. Default threads is one worker per core, same warmup and sample count (12).
